notes:
Company: Tiltbox Assist — lightweight SDK for in-app assistants inside other B2B SaaS apps.
Origin: inbound via docs/quickstart; used free credits.
Priority: latency > cost for UX, wants streaming (server->client) with sub-300ms first-byte in ideal path.
Tech stack: Typescript frontend + Node backend, uses websocket streaming.
Current status: discovery — evaluating hosted API for speed + ease of integration. Trying self-serve first, likely to convert to paid if latency stable.
Requirements / asks:
- Streaming-enabled endpoints with per-route token breakdown.
- Example configs for low-latency (continuous batching off, small sequence optimizations).
- Documentation for SDK websocket reconnect semantics and partial-response parsing.
- Cost estimate for target volume: 2M messages/month, avg 40 tokens in/out.
Security: SOC2 expected within product; SSO/SAML planned for customers but Tiltbox wants audit logs and retention controls. Not asking for private deployment yet.
Model preferences: prefer latency-optimized medium models (approx 7B) and a deterministic fallback to smaller model for peak load. Interested in Redwood-curated profile recommendations.
QUOTES: "We need streaming that doesn't feel laggy in the UI — first token matters more than throughput."
POC criteria: stable p95 latency <350ms for 70% of flows; clear guidance on batching/kv-cache to avoid regressions.
Docs/links: pricing deck shared (drive link), demo transcript (fireflies).
Next call: 2026-03-15 30m sync to review trial metrics and agree go/no-go for paid card activation.
Open items: clarify SLA options for hosted tier, and whether token-level billing visibility can be exported to their billing analytics stack.
